# rex-grokbot-bridge

> An MCP server and webhook bridge for macOS that lets Grok Bot, over Tailscale, see and drive the coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Grok Build, shells) running in your Rex terminal, and get pinged when they finish or get stuck.

Install with `npm i -g rex-grokbot-bridge` (or the curl installer), then run `rex-grokbot setup`. By default the bot drives only the Rex sessions and panes the user shares with it. The CLI is `rex-grokbot`; `rex-grokbot --help` and `rex-grokbot doctor` are the first things to run.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smarzban/rex-grokbot-bridge/main/README.md): what it is, how it works, quickstart.
- [Setup, upgrade, uninstall](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smarzban/rex-grokbot-bridge/main/docs/setup.md): install paths, what `rex-grokbot setup` does, Tailscale Serve port, non-interactive flags.
- [Security model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smarzban/rex-grokbot-bridge/main/docs/security.md): modes, sharing sessions and panes, what notifies the bot, protections.
- [Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smarzban/rex-grokbot-bridge/main/docs/reference.md): every CLI command, the MCP tools, settings, files and paths.
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smarzban/rex-grokbot-bridge/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): when the bot can't reach the Mac, and other problems.
- [Grok Bot guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smarzban/rex-grokbot-bridge/main/docs/grok-bot.md): addressed to Grok Bot; it walks the user through connecting the bot.
